app.subtitle: Exercise Wiki
app.loadError: Failed to load data. Try reloading the page.

favorites.empty: You have no favourite exercises yet. Add them by tapping the star next to an exercise.
favorites.heading: Favourite exercises
favorites.panelEmpty: You have no favourite exercises yet. Add them by clicking the star next to an exercise.

plan.title: Workout {number}
plan.empty: Workout {number} is empty. Add exercises from the list or the exercise detail with the ⊕ button.
plan.hint: Reorder with the arrows. Workouts are stored only in this browser.
plan.lockedHint: Workouts are locked – exercises cannot be moved or removed. Unlock them with the lock icon.
plan.lock: Lock workouts (prevents moving and removing exercises)
plan.lockedRemove: Workouts are locked – {name} cannot be removed
plan.copied: Link copied. Send it to anyone – opening it shows this workout.
plan.sharedIntro: Someone sent you this workout via a link. You can save it as your own.
plan.sharedEmpty: The link contains no known exercises.
plan.replaceConfirm: Replace your workout {number} (exercises: {count}) with this shared one?
plan.mapPrimary: Number of exercises per muscle group. Primary: {list}.

bodymap.heading: Muscles
bodymap.hint: Tap a muscle to filter exercises. Tap again to clear the filter.

week.title: Week
week.intro: Summary of workouts 1–4. A muscle group counts as trained when at least 1 exercise works it as primary, or at least 2 exercises as secondary.
week.empty: All workouts are empty. Add exercises to workouts 1–4 and you will see which muscle groups were left out.
week.missedHint: Tap to show exercises that work the muscle group as primary.
week.mapTrained: Number of exercises per muscle group this week. Trained: {list}.
week.newWeekConfirm: Clear all workouts 1–4 and start a new week?

log.heading: Log
log.rirHint: Optional: how many reps were left before failure.
log.errorWeight: Enter a weight of 0–1000 kg (0 = bodyweight).
log.errorRir: RIR must be a whole number 0–10, or leave the field empty.
log.memoryOnly: The browser does not allow storing data (e.g. private window). Sets will be kept only until the page is closed.

history.title: History
history.empty: You have no logged sets yet. Log a set in the exercise detail, in the Log section.

calendar.hint: Tap a day with a workout to jump to its log.

backup.title: Data backup
backup.intro: Sets, favourites and workouts are stored only in this browser. Save a backup to a file and keep it safe (Google Drive, e-mail…). You can restore it on another device too.
backup.errorJson: The file is not valid JSON.
backup.errorNotBackup: The file is not a Hypertrophica backup.
backup.errorVersion: The backup comes from a newer version of the app. Update the app first (reload the page) and repeat the import.
backup.errorImport: Import failed. Data on this device is unchanged.
backup.preview: Backup from {date}: sets {sets}, favourites {favorites}, exercises in workouts {workouts}.
backup.previewSkipped: Invalid sets or sets of unknown exercises will be skipped: {count}.
backup.modeHint: Merge: adds sets missing on this device, combines favourites and fills only empty workouts. Replace: deletes data on this device and restores it from the backup.
backup.merge: Merge with data on this device
backup.replaceConfirm: Really delete all data on this device (sets, favourites, workouts) and replace it with the backup?
backup.imported: Import complete. Sets: added {added}, updated {updated}, unchanged {unchanged}.
backup.csvEmpty: There are no logged sets to export yet.
